text:
Stennis Bank is the lender behind the Garrow Heights housing scheme, financing the project with a construction loan facility of £84.6 million.

The financing agreement was signed on 14 March 2023 at a ceremony in Garrow Heights town hall, where this reporter was present. Marguerite Ostrander, Director of Municipal Lending at Stennis Bank, signed for the lender.

The facility covers construction of all 420 units in the scheme. The Garrow Heights Development Financing Agreement has been filed with the Harlow Vale Planning Registry, where it is available for inspection.

Those at the ceremony watched the signatures go onto the document in the main hall. Ostrander signed on behalf of the bank, and the agreement was announced to the room once the paperwork was complete.

The Gazette will continue to follow the scheme as work gets under way.
